title: Front re-nucleation in the wave-pinning crawler: after a 40% front cut the cell stops as a round, non-polar disk, then breaks symmetry by itself and crawls off on a new heading (4 of 6 labkit seeds, 2 of 3 side-by-side runs)
summary: Same world as 20261025T1955-c22-wavepin-front-competition-claim: the Camley crawler with per-body pools, rho*=0.2 and noise eta=2. A 40% front sector cut at t=8 removes 38-39% of the area and 45-46% of the protein (it leaves the cell), leaving at most 0.06-0.10 of polarized area. Then: (1) the remnant floods the shrunken cell, and the cell stops as a round disk with rho uniformly high, which has no front: the polarity offset |d| (rho*phi centroid minus phi centroid) falls from 0.27-0.35 to 0.001-0.006, and the rho contrast inside drops to the noise level (0.17-0.18) for t~9.0-10.7 (polcheck_s0_cut40.txt, polcheck_s2_cut40.txt; classify.txt). (2) The disk swells; as the high state passes 1/2 the uniform state becomes unstable and noise breaks the symmetry: a new front forms at t~10.5-11.5. (3) The cell crawls on at 0.35-0.36 (twin 0.42), on a heading new to it: 20, 136 and ~180 degrees from its own pre-cut heading on seeds 0 (side-by-side), 2 (side-by-side) and 5 (labkit). Counts: labkit packs with this cut on seeds 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 give a non-polar disk on 0, 3, 4 and 5, re-nucleation and crawling on 0, 3 and 5, and on 4 a uniform collapse to the low state and death at t~11.5. Seed 2 takes the competition path of the parent claim (two surviving lobes, one wins). Side-by-side runs with twins (cutrun.py, different post-cut noise): seeds 0 and 2 re-nucleate, seed 1 takes the competition path. A 50% cut leaves no high remnant and the cell dies by t=8.7 (cuts/r2_s0_front0.5). Undamaged twins never lose their polarity (|d| >= 0.33, classify.txt).

claims.statement: A planted crawler (one per run) crawling at 0.42 loses its front to a 40% front cut. On 3 of 5 labkit seeds (0, 3, 5) and 2 of 3 side-by-side seeds (0, 2), the same individual passes through a round, non-polar, non-motile disk (|d| <= 0.006 for ~1-1.5 time units) and re-nucleates a front by symmetry breaking. It then crawls on at 0.35-0.36 on a heading new to it, while its undamaged twin crawls on unchanged. The re-nucleation can fail: one seed collapses to the low state and dies, and one takes the parent claim's competition path. Commands: python -m labkit.run world.py --seeds <s> --frames 100 --no-movie with WORLD_P='{"cut_t":8.0,"cut_mode":"front","cut_frac":0.4}' (twins: no WORLD_P); cutrun.py world.py <s> 8 20 <out> with WORLD_P='{"cut_mode":"front","cut_frac":0.4}'; polcheck.py with the same WORLD_P.
claims.track: seed 0, packs/front40_seed0 track 0 (the only track, 101/101 frames): crawls t=0-8, cut at t=8, uniform non-polar disk t~8.6-10.4, new front t~11, crawls t=11-20 (sheet.png); the same seed side by side with its twin in cuts/r2_s0_front0.4/cut.png and polcheck_s0_cut40.txt

controls_run.R: undamaged twins packs/twin_seed0 and packs/twin_seed2 (identical until t=8; |d| >= 0.33 throughout, classify.txt) and the twins drawn in cuts/r2_s*_front0.4/cut.png; dose arm cuts/r2_s0_front0.5 (no remnant: death); failure cases packs/front40_seed4 (death) and packs/front40_seed2 (competition path)
controls_run.M: the linear-kinetics twin of the same world, research/alife/collective/contrib/20261025T1955-c22-wavepin-front-competition-claim/pack_linear: no polarity, no motion

claims.bd_control: the parent claim's pack_linear (KIN=1, linear relaxation at the cubic's rate): the cell never polarizes, so neither crawling nor re-nucleation can occur

limits: The non-polar intermediate is reached only because a small high remnant floods the shrunken cell; with no remnant (50% cut) the cell dies. Re-nucleation needs the world's noise and the low contractility (rho*=0.2): in the parent sighting, a uniform disk without noise collapses and dies, and at rho*=0.4 uniform disks are stable and static. Whether a run re-nucleates, competes or dies depends on the noise after the cut. The planted crawler gives no S, and B is not claimed (Allen-Cahn contour). One cut time; speeds converge only to ~8% in dt (parent numerics finding).
